live_gaps.cause: No code failure and no error: the monthly runbook was simply never invoked. Attention went to the Markov diagnostics (2026-07-30 → 2026-08-19, layer shelved) and the news-backfill fix (2026-08-11). The 2026-07-13 run was the last live invocation.
live_gaps.cause_amendment_2026-09-01: The 'no code failure' characterisation is incomplete. A latent bug in feature_matrix._load_fundamental_scores() built its monthly forward-fill scaffold ending at the last QUARTER-end rather than the requested month-end, so months after the last completed quarter came back with 13/20 factor columns NaN (65% > the 50% NAN_DROP_THRESHOLD) and were dropped entirely. The feature matrix could therefore only ever reach the last completed quarter. Sprint 8 did not surface this because 2026-06-30 IS a quarter-end. Had the 2026-08-03 rebalance been invoked on schedule it would have scored 2026-06 and silently rebalanced into a stale month. Fixed 2026-09-01 by extending the scaffold to max(last_quarter_end, requested_end); the change is purely additive (+106 rows = 2 months x 53 tickers, no historical row altered) and restores the behaviour the function's docstring already specified. No model, FEATURE_COLS, MIN_SCORE, TOP_N or pickle change.
